# gtld-servers.net
> Authoritative DNS root and TLD name server hostnames operated for top-level domain resolution.

This site publishes the canonical hostname lists for root and top-level domain name servers, primarily under the a.gtld-servers.net through m.gtld-servers.net naming scheme used by many generic top-level domains.

## Core Site
- [gtld-servers.net](https://gtld-servers.net/): Main index for the gtld-servers.net authoritative name server hostnames.
- [A.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://a.gtld-servers.net/): Hostname endpoint for the A gtld-servers.net authoritative name server.
- [B.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://b.gtld-servers.net/): Hostname endpoint for the B gtld-servers.net authoritative name server.
- [C.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://c.gtld-servers.net/): Hostname endpoint for the C gtld-servers.net authoritative name server.
- [D.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://d.gtld-servers.net/): Hostname endpoint for the D gtld-servers.net authoritative name server.
- [E.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://e.gtld-servers.net/): Hostname endpoint for the E gtld-servers.net authoritative name server.

## Name Server Hosts A–F
- [A.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://a.gtld-servers.net/): Authoritative gtld-servers.net host used for TLD DNS service.

- [F.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://f.gtld-servers.net/): Authoritative gtld-servers.net host used for TLD DNS service.

## Operational Reference
- [A.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://a.gtld-servers.net/): Canonical hostname commonly published in NS records for many generic TLDs.
- [B.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://b.gtld-servers.net/): Canonical hostname commonly published in NS records for many generic TLDs.
- [C.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://c.gtld-servers.net/): Canonical hostname commonly published in NS records for many generic TLDs.
- [D.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://d.gtld-servers.net/): Canonical hostname commonly published in NS records for many generic TLDs.
- [E.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://e.gtld-servers.net/): Canonical hostname commonly published in NS records for many generic TLDs.
- [F.GTLD-SERVERS.NET](https://f.gtld-servers.net/): Canonical hostname commonly published in NS records for many generic TLDs.
